name: omp-skill-state
description: Run a procedural skill against an explicit execution state instead of a growing transcript (omp plugin)

scripts.repomix: repomix --style markdown --output repomix-src.md --include "src/**,docs/**,skills/**,tsconfig.json,package.json,CONTEXT.md,README.md,AGENTS.md" && repomix --style markdown --output repomix-tests.md --include "test/**,verification/**"
